title: The scalar balancing and pullback square on complexes
statement: For a commutative ring map phi:A -> B, a scheme map f:Z -> W and an A-module sheaf complex P on W, apply the ordinary balancing/pullback square [lem-pur-scalar-sheaf-tensor-pullback] degreewise. The resulting maps of complexes commute: inverse image of balancing, then the restriction/pullback complex iso and restriction of the scalar/pullback complex iso, equals the tensor/pullback complex iso [lem-pur-upper-star-single-tensor-representative] followed by balancing after inverse image. All composition comparisons are the canonical mapHomologicalComplexCompIso maps. No K-flatness or flatness assumption is needed.

proof.text: For four preadditive categories and a commuting ordinary square of functors, lift the square to cochain complexes. The canonical composition-iso components are the ordinary iso components followed by identities; these identity factors cancel degreewise. Specialize to the ordinary scalar balancing/pullback square. The tensor comparison is the ordinary inverse-image tensor comparison followed by the coefficient-sheaf iso.

theorem scalarSheafTensorPullbackComplex_square
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B)
    {Z W : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ W)
    (P : CochainComplex (Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) ℤ) :
    ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
        ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (scalarSheafTensorTransformation φ W)
          (.up ℤ)).app P) ≫
      (Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso (upperStarRestrictScalarsIsoSheaf φ f) (.up ℤ) ≪≫
        (Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso (Iso.refl
          (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) f ⋙ Sheaf.restrictScalars Z.smallEtaleTopology φ))
          (.up ℤ)).symm).hom.app
        (((ProEtale.etaleSheafExtendScalars φ W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
      ((Sheaf.restrictScalars Z.smallEtaleTopology φ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
        ((scalarSheafPullbackComplexIso φ f).hom.app P) =
    (Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso
        (upperStarTensorSingleIso A f (scalarCoefficientSheafPullbackIso φ f)) (.up ℤ) ≪≫
      (Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso (Iso.refl
        (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f ⋙ tensorRight (scalarCoefficientSheaf φ Z)))
        (.up ℤ)).symm).hom.app P ≫
      (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (scalarSheafTensorTransformation φ Z) (.up ℤ)).app
        (((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
